claims.hypothesis: PCA can effectively extract features in a galaxy with both an AGN and an SB ring
claims.experiment: PCA of standardized 150 pc integrated intensity maps of 13 lines, for the overall (~2 kpc) region and the SB ring region
claims.result: PC1 traces approximate H2 column density; PC2_OA separates CND/AGN from the SB ring; PC3 and PC2_SB separate bar-end, spiral-arm, SSC and outflow-direction features
claims.finding: PCA effectively extracts features even in AGN + SB ring galaxies

evidence.loc: 5 Summary
evidence.quote: This study demonstrated that PCA can effectively extract features even in complex galaxies with the AGN and the SB ring.

claims.hypothesis: The overall-region PCA maps reflect H2 column density and density/chemistry differences between the CND and SB ring
claims.experiment: Inspection of PC1_OA and PC2_OA score maps and coefficients, with correlations to extra lines
claims.result: PC1_OA coefficients all positive; PC2_OA positive scores near AGN and CND, negative along the SB ring
claims.finding: PC1 reconstructs approximate H2 column density; PC2 reflects CND vs SB ring density and/or chemical composition

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: have a possibility to reconstruct a map representing the approximate H$_2$ column density and difference of volume density and/or chemical composition between the circumnuclear disk (CND) and the starburst ring (SB ring)

claims.finding: Approximate H2 column density and a starburst-versus-shock distinction

referee_caveats_inferred: The AGN outflow interpretation of PC3_SB rests on map morphology and a correlation with velocity dispersion; no independent check of outflow-driven chemistry (e.g. line ratios, radiative transfer)
PCA is linear and PC3 mixes several effects; interpretation of coefficients by tracer roles is qualitative and partly circular
Choices such as standardization, the 60-hexagon line threshold and the SB ring mask can change low-order PCs (the appendix shows PC3 changes)
Spatial correlations between hexagons and CND/AGN contamination of the ring region are not treated; Monte Carlo errors include only moment 0 noise
Coefficient errors are tiny (1e-4 to 1e-2) and may understate systematic uncertainties from heterogeneous projects and calibration
